cases.description: The supplied id equals the id of one of the VersionFlag enum constants, therefore the method should set `found` to true and return the original id unchanged.

group: Id does not match any VersionFlag and does not contain a draft URL

cases.description: The id is not a known VersionFlag and does not contain the substring "://json-schema.org/draft"; the method should skip all normalisation logic and return the original id.
The id contains the generic draft marker and the specific "/draft-07/" segment, so the method should replace the whole id with `SchemaId.V7`.
The id contains the generic draft marker and the "/draft/2019-09/" segment; the method should replace it with `SchemaId.V201909`.
The id contains the generic draft marker and the "/draft/2020-12/" segment; the method should replace it with `SchemaId.V202012`.
The id contains the generic draft marker and the "/draft-04/" segment; the method should replace it with `SchemaId.V4`.
The id contains the generic draft marker and the "/draft-06/" segment; the method should replace it with `SchemaId.V6`.

group: Id contains draft marker but none of the recognised sub‑paths

cases.description: The id contains the generic draft marker but none of the specific sub‑paths checked by the else‑if chain; the method should leave the id unchanged.
The supplied id equals the id of the VersionFlag enum constant for Draft‑04, therefore `found` becomes true and the method returns the original id unchanged.
The supplied id equals the id of the VersionFlag enum constant for Draft‑06, causing the method to return the unchanged id.
The supplied id equals the id of the VersionFlag enum constant for Draft‑2019‑09, so the method returns it unchanged.
The supplied id equals the id of the VersionFlag enum constant for Draft‑2020‑12, therefore no normalisation occurs.
Passing a null reference causes a NPE when the method attempts to call `contains` or `equals` on it.

group: Empty string id returns empty string

cases.description: An empty string does not match any VersionFlag and does not contain the draft marker, so the method returns it unchanged.

group: Id contains both draft‑07 and draft‑04, normalises to V7 (order test)

cases.description: The string contains the generic marker and both recognised sub‑paths. Because the method checks for `/draft-07/` before `/draft-04/`, it normalises to the V7 constant.

group: Id contains draft‑07 without trailing slash – no normalisation

cases.description: The generic marker is present but the specific sub‑path `/draft-07/` (with a trailing slash) is not, so the method leaves the id unchanged.

group: Id contains generic marker with uppercase domain – no normalisation

cases.description: The `contains` check is case‑sensitive; the uppercase domain prevents detection of the draft marker, so the id is returned unchanged.

group: Id contains generic marker with different scheme (ftp) – normalises

cases.description: Even though the scheme is `ftp`, the substring `://json-schema.org/draft` is present, and the recognised `/draft-06/` segment triggers normalisation to `SchemaId.V6`.
